body_markdown:
Business of Cannabis spoke with Stefan Adomeit, Co-Founder and Managing Director of Remexian Pharma GmbH, one year on from High Tide's acquisition of a majority stake in the German medical cannabis wholesaler. Adomeit reports orders up approximately 50% since the transaction, and discusses Remexian's resilience through Germany's recent decision to end statutory health insurance reimbursement for cannabis flower.


Recently, High Tide announced on August 4, 2026 that Remexian distributed over 10 tonnes of medical cannabis flower during the third fiscal quarter ended July 31, 2026, an all-time quarterly distribution record representing growth of 33% sequentially and 60% year over year.
